options.reason: The table was assembled to relate protein abundance to HER2 status: it holds one labelled row per tumour (122 rows, 122 unique sample_id) with 11,690 float protein features and a two-level outcome label (15 HER2-positive, 107 negative). That makes HER2 status a binary classification target predicted from the proteome, with sample_id excluded as a row key and cross-validated classifier comparison.
options.title: binary
